description: ol-reserved-word (issue #837, maintainer ruling #833): DECLARING `mod` collides. `mod` is a word-spelled operator of the expression grammar rather than a callable primitive (spec/grammar.md:380). Its token class is a separate, independent axis and does NOT change -- `mod` stays `operator`, exactly as `and` does, because spec/grammar.md:380 makes the `keyword` token class and the keyword list "different sets on purpose". Binding and calling `mod` are unaffected: keyword-mod-binds-and-calls-freely pins those. `"check": true` (semantic-checker only) -- nothing is executed and no events are produced.
